summary: This directory provides a centralized repository for path transformation utilities. It facilitates consistent file system path normalization and maintains accurate bidirectional mappings between source code files and their corresponding build outputs, supporting reliable file navigation and identification.
responsibilities: Normalize file system paths for consistent processing
Map source file paths to build output paths
Map build output paths to source file paths
Identify test files based on project conventions
relationships: Path normalization provides the foundation for consistent path mapping operations.
Mapping functions transform file path representations between source and build output contexts.
Test file identification logic relies on path normalization to ensure accurate pattern matching.
designDecisions: Centralization of path transformation logic for consistency
Encapsulation of file system mapping rules
